rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Thank you, Teacher Adette. You really saved us.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Teacher Adette. You really
saved us.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Don't celebrate yet...! Those guys haven't given up!
rows.display_text:
「Don't celebrate yet...! Those guys
haven't given up!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Commander Asuham has started walking his own path now. So I'll do as I please too.
rows.display_text:
「Commander Asuham has started walking
his own path now. So I'll do as I please
too.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: To get back into Saint Regan from the fading Sibe Rail, I'll capture that little brat...!
rows.display_text:
「To get back into Saint Regan from the
fading Sibe Rail, I'll capture that little
brat...!」

rows.speaker: Sibe Rail Guard
rows.en: Commander Zakki...! The one riding that red Dobeck is believed to be Adette Kistler.
rows.display_text:
「Commander Zakki...! The one riding that
red Dobeck is believed to be Adette
Kistler.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: The heroine of the old Sibe Rail security force, huh. But she's alone in a single machine. There's nothing she can do.
rows.display_text:
「The heroine of the old Sibe Rail
security force, huh. But alone in a single
machine, there's nothing she can do.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Let Sibe Rail handle Sibe Rail's business! Dogozzo squad, pin down that red Dobeck!
rows.display_text:
「Let Sibe Rail handle Sibe Rail's
business! Dogozzo squad, pin down that
red Dobeck!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Teacher Adette! The enemy's coming! There's so many of them!
rows.display_text:
「Teacher Adette! The enemy's coming!
There's so many of them!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: No need to worry, Ana. For your sake too, I can't afford to lose here!
rows.display_text:
「No need to worry, Ana. For your sake
too, I can't afford to lose here!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Teacher Adette...
rows.display_text: 「Teacher Adette...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: When it's time to go, I go...! Hold on tight, Ana!
rows.display_text:
「When it's time to go, I go...! Hold on
tight, Ana!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Yes!
rows.display_text: 「Yes!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: All right, bring it on! I'm a tough one today!!
rows.display_text:
「All right, bring it on! I'm a tough one
today!!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: They're flinching...! Now's my chance to break through!!
rows.display_text:
「They're flinching...! Now's my chance to
break through!!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Tch! It's just one Silhouette Machine -- what are you all wasting time for!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! It's just one Silhouette Machine
-- what are you all wasting time for!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Tch! Slipped up!!
rows.display_text: 「Tch! Slipped up!!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Don't move, Adette Kistler! Resist, and I'll crush the cockpit!
rows.display_text:
「Don't move, Adette Kistler! Resist, and
I'll crush the cockpit!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Don't you look down on me, small fry! If bowing my head to the likes of you is the price, I'll go down fighting instead!
rows.display_text:
「Don't you look down on me, small fry!
If bowing my head to the likes of you is
the price, I'll go down fighting instead!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Oh? Even if it means dragging Ana Medaiyu down with you?
rows.display_text:
「Oh? Even if it means dragging Ana
Medaiyu down with you?」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Certainly, a pilot of your skill could shove the Golem aside and still land a hit on me.
rows.display_text:
「Certainly, a pilot of your skill could
shove the Golem aside and still land a hit
on me.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: But you won't come out unscathed. And when that happens, what will become of Ana Medaiyu, I wonder?
rows.display_text:
「But you won't come out unscathed. And
when that happens, what will become of
Ana Medaiyu, I wonder?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Ngh...

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Even if you survive, an ordinary child could end up with a fatal wound if things go wrong.
rows.display_text:
「Even if you survive, an ordinary child
could end up with a fatal wound if things
go wrong.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: What are you spacing out for, Adette Kistler! Fight properly!
rows.display_text:
「What are you spacing out for, Adette
Kistler! Fight properly!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Ana...! Are you sure you're ready for this...
rows.display_text:
「Ana...! Are you sure you're ready for
this...」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: You're opening the cockpit? Have you decided to surrender?
rows.display_text:
「You're opening the cockpit? Have you
decided to surrender?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Pilot of that Overman, listen to me.
rows.display_text: 「Pilot of that Overman, listen to me.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Wh-what...!?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what...!?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Capturing me to get what you want is your goal here, isn't it...
rows.display_text:
「Capturing me to get what you want is
your goal here, isn't it...」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: What do you think someone who resorts to such a cowardly trick could possibly accomplish!
rows.display_text:
「What do you think someone who resorts
to such a cowardly trick could possibly
accomplish!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: If you're enough of a warrior to ride an Overman, then know some shame!
rows.display_text:
「If you're enough of a warrior to ride
an Overman, then know some shame!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: There's no way an act this contemptible could ever achieve a great ambition!
rows.display_text:
「There's no way an act this contemptible
could ever achieve a great ambition!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Ana... you're giving me chills!
rows.display_text: 「Ana... you're giving me chills!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: ...Even if you're just a country lord's daughter, I'll grant you're every bit the princess of a nation.
rows.display_text:
「...Even if you're just a country lord's
daughter, I'll grant you're every bit the
princess of a nation.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: But now that you've insulted me, you'll have to pay for it with a little pain!
rows.display_text:
「But now that you've insulted me, you'll
have to pay for it with a little pain!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: I won't let you!
rows.display_text: 「I won't let you!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Kyaah!
rows.display_text: 「Kyaah!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Uoooooooooh!!
rows.display_text: 「Uoooooooooh!!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Did you see that!? Behold the Lady-Teacher Ninja Art: the Technique of Emergency Superhuman Strength!!
rows.display_text:
「Did you see that!? Behold the
Lady-Teacher Ninja Art: the Technique
of Emergency Superhuman Strength!!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Tch! She threw herself on the line to let the brat escape!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! She threw herself on the line to
let the brat escape!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Adette Kistler! Why would you do something like that!? That means you're going to...
rows.display_text:
「Adette Kistler! Why would you do
something like that!? That means you're
going to...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Sorry, Ana. Looks like I can only keep half of my promise.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry, Ana. Looks like I can only keep
half of my promise.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Eh...

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: I managed to protect you, but for getting word to Wulgusk, you'll have to ask Gauli or someone.
rows.display_text:
「I managed to protect you, but for
getting word to Wulgusk, you'll have to
ask Gauli or someone.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: No...! Adette! You mustn't die!
rows.display_text: 「No...! Adette! You mustn't die!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: If I become that man's, you'll be saved!
rows.display_text: 「If I become that man's, you'll be saved!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Protecting children is a grown-up's job. You may be a princess, but you're still a kid... so listen to your big sister this time.
rows.display_text:
「Protecting children is a grown-up's job.
Princess or not, you're still a kid... so
listen to your big sister this time.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Adette!!
rows.display_text: 「Adette!!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Fine resolve, woman! Then, just as you wish, I'll take that life of yours!!
rows.display_text:
「Fine resolve, woman! Then, just as you
wish, I'll take that life of yours!!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: (Gauli... I'm sorry...!)
rows.display_text: （(Gauli... I'm sorry...!)）

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Wha--!?

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Now!
rows.display_text: 「Now!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Adette!
rows.display_text: 「Adette!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Looks like I'll be able to keep my promise after all!
rows.display_text:
「Looks like I'll be able to keep my
promise after all!」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: Are you all right, Adette!
rows.display_text: 「Are you all right, Adette!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: I was waiting for you, my beloved Yapan ninja.
rows.display_text:
「I was waiting for you, my beloved
Yapan ninja.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Princess Ana...! What in the world were you and Teacher Adette doing...!?
rows.display_text:
「Princess Ana...! What in the world were
you and Teacher Adette doing...!?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: That's...
rows.display_text: 「That's...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Don't go poking your nose into girl talk, Gainer.
rows.display_text:
「Don't go poking your nose into girl
talk, Gainer.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: But...

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Quit your grumbling and hurry up and cover me.
rows.display_text:
「Quit your grumbling and hurry up and
cover me.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: I've got a debt to pay back to that petty little punk, after all!
rows.display_text:
「I've got a debt to pay back to that
petty little punk, after all!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes!」

rows.speaker: Ennil
rows.en: What a haughty woman. It's almost refreshing.
rows.display_text:
「What a haughty woman. It's almost
refreshing.」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: Really! Is that the type Commander Gauli likes?
rows.display_text:
「Really! Is that the type Commander
Gauli likes?」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: Heh...

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: That's a pretty confident smile...
rows.display_text: 「That's a pretty confident smile...」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: No need for silly questions. Let's hurry up and clean out these stray Sibe Rail stragglers.
rows.display_text:
「No need for silly questions. Let's hurry
up and clean out these stray Sibe Rail
stragglers.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Tch! Fine then, I'll just switch my prey from Ana Medaiyu to $c!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! Fine then, I'll just switch my prey
from Ana Medaiyu to $c!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Someone like you could never defeat $c!
rows.display_text:
「Someone like you could never defeat
$c!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Not that he's the type to listen, though.
rows.display_text:
「Not that he's the type to listen,
though.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: So I'll just have to make him understand the hard way! And settle that earlier debt while I'm at it!
rows.display_text:
「So I'll just have to make him
understand the hard way! And settle that
earlier debt while I'm at it!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Now then... with that nuisance out of the way, let's take care of our own business.
rows.display_text:
「Now then... with that nuisance out of
the way, let's take care of our own
business.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: That business being...?
rows.display_text: 「That business being...?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Like I said before. It's girl talk.
rows.display_text: 「Like I said before. It's girl talk.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Seems like we're in the way here.
rows.display_text: 「Seems like we're in the way here.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Well then, we'll head back first. Let's go, Gainer.
rows.display_text:
「Well then, we'll head back first. Let's
go, Gainer.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Y-yes...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes...」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Thank you, Teacher Adette. I'm truly glad to have met someone like you.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Teacher Adette. I'm truly
glad to have met someone like you.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Told you, didn't I? A princess sure knows quality when she sees it.
rows.display_text:
「Told you, didn't I? A princess sure
knows quality when she sees it.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: R-ridiculous! I escaped Commander Asuham, only to lose here!?
rows.display_text:
「R-ridiculous! I escaped Commander
Asuham, only to lose here!?」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Ngh, I'll come back another day! Someday, mark my words, I will reclaim my place!!
rows.display_text:
「Ngh, I'll come back another day!
Someday, mark my words, I will reclaim my
place!!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: So he was Asuham's aide. Well... that's about the caliber he deserves.
rows.display_text:
「So he was Asuham's aide. Well... that's
about the caliber he deserves.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Big dreams, small cup. With a vessel like that, there's only so much hope he could ever hold.
rows.display_text:
「Big dreams, small cup. With a vessel
like that, there's only so much hope he
could ever hold.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Hold on tight, Ana! My driving's a little rough!
rows.display_text:
「Hold on tight, Ana! My driving's a little
rough!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: D-don't worry about me, just do as you see fit!
rows.display_text:
「D-don't worry about me, just do as you
see fit!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: ...You don't have to push yourself. Even I was scared my first time in real combat.
rows.display_text:
「...You don't have to push yourself. Even
I was scared my first time in real
combat.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Though I was a lot older than you are now.
rows.display_text:
「Though I was a lot older than you are
now.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: No matter what happens, you came to rely on me, and I'll make sure you're protected!
rows.display_text:
「No matter what happens, you came to
rely on me, and I'll make sure you're
protected!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: 'Teacher' just means someone born earlier...! And it's an adult's job to protect a child, plain and simple!
rows.display_text:
「'Teacher' just means someone born
earlier...! And it's an adult's job to
protect a child, plain and simple!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Adette Kistler! Because you resisted needlessly, all my plans fell apart!
rows.display_text:
「Adette Kistler! Because you resisted
needlessly, all my plans fell apart!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Blaming your own failure on somebody else just shows how shallow you really are.
rows.display_text:
「Blaming your own failure on somebody
else just shows how shallow you really
are.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: I fall for a strong man even if he's my enemy. But you? You don't even qualify!
rows.display_text:
「I fall for a strong man even if he's my
enemy. But you? You don't even qualify!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Weak little men need not apply!
rows.display_text: 「Weak little men need not apply!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Black Southern Cross! If Commander Asuham hadn't gone chasing after you, I never would have fallen this far!
rows.display_text:
「Black Southern Cross! If Commander
Asuham hadn't gone chasing after you, I
never would have fallen this far!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Blaming me out of spite, huh. Figures, coming from one of Asuham Boone's men.
rows.display_text:
「Blaming me out of spite, huh. Figures,
coming from one of Asuham Boone's men.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: But even if he's a bit hot-headed, a man who can fight for his family earns my respect.
rows.display_text:
「But even if he's a bit hot-headed, a
man who can fight for his family earns
my respect.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: How is that respectable!? He's a man who's lost sight of everything around him over personal feelings!
rows.display_text:
「How is that respectable!? He's a man
who's lost sight of everything around him
over personal feelings!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Compared to a man who chases down kids just to save his own skin, he's far easier to love!
rows.display_text:
「Compared to a man who chases down
kids just to save his own skin, he's far
easier to love!」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: Hey, Gainer... do you know where Princess Ana went?
rows.display_text:
「Hey, Gainer... do you know where
Princess Ana went?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Now that you mention it, I haven't seen her in a while...
rows.display_text:
「Now that you mention it, I haven't seen
her in a while...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Even when I asked Maetel and the others, they said they didn't know.
rows.display_text:
「Even when I asked Maetel and the
others, they said they didn't know.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Maybe she just took Lins and the others out to play somewhere.
rows.display_text:
「Maybe she just took Lins and the
others out to play somewhere.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: All by herself? That's dangerous.
rows.display_text: 「All by herself? That's dangerous.」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: It'll be fine. Princess Ana has a good head on her shoulders.
rows.display_text:
「It'll be fine. Princess Ana has a good
head on her shoulders.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: What's wrong, Sara?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Sara?」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Yeah... Lately... Princess Ana's seemed a little down, so I got worried...
rows.display_text:
「Yeah... Lately... Princess Ana's seemed a
little down, so I got worried...」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: Don't tell me she ran away with something troubling her...!?
rows.display_text:
「Don't tell me she ran away with
something troubling her...!?」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: Well, Renton? What do you think?
rows.display_text: 「Well, Renton? What do you think?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Eh... why are you asking me about that...?
rows.display_text:
「Eh... why are you asking me about
that...?」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: You're the resident runaway expert, so you'd know, right...!?
rows.display_text:
「You're the resident runaway expert, so
you'd know, right...!?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Even if you put it that way...
rows.display_text: 「Even if you put it that way...」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: No need to worry about Princess Ana. I saw her head out to the nearby town with Adette earlier.
rows.display_text:
「No need to worry about Princess Ana. I
saw her head out to the nearby town
with Adette earlier.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: With Teacher Adette, huh.
rows.display_text: 「With Teacher Adette, huh.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Somehow, I've got a bad feeling about this...
rows.display_text:
「Somehow, I've got a bad feeling about
this...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: ...Was that really all right, Princess Ana? Not telling Gainer where you were headed.
rows.display_text:
「...Was that really all right, Princess
Ana? Not telling Gainer where you were
headed.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: I didn't want to worry him needlessly.
rows.display_text: 「I didn't want to worry him needlessly.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Then why did you ask me to be your chauffeur?
rows.display_text:
「Then why did you ask me to be your
chauffeur?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: I don't mind, since I had nothing else going on, but I'd like to hear at least the reason you wanted to come to this town.
rows.display_text:
「I don't mind, since I had nothing else
going on, but I'd like to at least hear
why you wanted to come to this town.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: It's fine. I'm a woman who keeps her mouth shut.
rows.display_text:
「It's fine. I'm a woman who keeps her
mouth shut.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: If you tell me to keep it secret, I won't breathe a word to anyone.
rows.display_text:
「If you tell me to keep it secret, I
won't breathe a word to anyone.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Really?
rows.display_text: 「Really?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: It's a promise between women. I wouldn't crack even if you killed me.
rows.display_text:
「It's a promise between women. I
wouldn't crack even if you killed me.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Then, Adette Kistler... I'll trust you and tell you everything.
rows.display_text:
「Then, Adette Kistler... I'll trust you
and tell you everything.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: I want to get in touch with my father in Wulgusk.
rows.display_text:
「I want to get in touch with my father
in Wulgusk.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Your father would be Duke Medaiyu, the lord of Wulgusk, then.
rows.display_text:
「Your father would be Duke Medaiyu, the
lord of Wulgusk, then.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: What, is this... homesickness?
rows.display_text: 「What, is this... homesickness?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: It's not that...! I'm on the Exodus of my own free will.
rows.display_text:
「It's not that...! I'm on the Exodus of
my own free will.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: It's just...
rows.display_text: 「It's just...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Just...?
rows.display_text: 「Just...?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Kizz Munt had it in for us after we succeeded in our Exodus.
rows.display_text:
「Kizz Munt had it in for us after we
succeeded in our Exodus.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: I worry he might be taking that same anger out on Wulgusk...
rows.display_text:
「I worry he might be taking that same
anger out on Wulgusk...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: We already took down Kizz Munt's trump card, the Overdevil. He'll probably lay low for a while.
rows.display_text:
「We already took down Kizz Munt's trump
card, the Overdevil. He'll probably lay low
for a while.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: But that doesn't mean Sibe Rail is gone.
rows.display_text:
「But that doesn't mean Sibe Rail is
gone.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: As long as Sibe Rail controls Siberia's economy and supply lines, there are countless ways to strike at Dome Polis.
rows.display_text:
「As long as Sibe Rail controls Siberia's
economy and supply lines, there are
countless ways to strike at Dome Polis.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: ...That man's been playing king since the day he was born. He's certainly not the type to stay quiet after being made a fool of.
rows.display_text:
「...That man's played king since the day
he was born. He's not the type to stay
quiet after being made a fool of.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: That's why I wanted to come to this town's UN Center -- to confirm my father's safety.
rows.display_text:
「That's why I wanted to come to this
town's UN Center -- to confirm my
father's safety.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: There's a UN terminal on $c's ship too, you know. Couldn't you just use that?
rows.display_text:
「There's a UN terminal on $c's ship
too, you know. Couldn't you just use
that?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: If I used $c's UN terminal, Gainer and the others would surely notice and worry about me...
rows.display_text:
「If I used $c's UN terminal, Gainer and
the others would surely notice and worry
about me...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: So you wanted to do it without them seeing... and that's why you came to me.
rows.display_text:
「So you wanted to do it without them
seeing... and that's why you came to me.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: You figured I wouldn't worry about you, is that it?
rows.display_text:
「You figured I wouldn't worry about you,
is that it?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: That's not what I meant...!
rows.display_text: 「That's not what I meant...!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: I'm just teasing. But you know, princess... you've got a real eye for quality.
rows.display_text:
「I'm just teasing. But you know,
princess... you've got a real eye for
quality.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: The young master and young miss types would probably fuss over you too much, sure enough...
rows.display_text:
「The young master and young miss types
would probably fuss over you too much,
sure enough...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Which means choosing me was the right call all along.
rows.display_text:
「Which means choosing me was the right
call all along.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Adette Kistler...
rows.display_text: 「Adette Kistler...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: I promise. Since you told me everything properly, I'll back you all the way.
rows.display_text:
「I promise. Since you told me everything
properly, I'll back you all the way.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Just leave everything to your Teacher Adette.
rows.display_text:
「Just leave everything to your Teacher
Adette.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Yes...! Thank you so much!
rows.display_text: 「Yes...! Thank you so much!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Pardon the interruption... I believe you're Princess Ana, daughter of Duke Medaiyu of Wulgusk.
rows.display_text:
「Pardon the interruption... I believe
you're Princess Ana, daughter of Duke
Medaiyu of Wulgusk.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: You... you're with Saint Regan!
rows.display_text: 「You... you're with Saint Regan!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Much to my displeasure, 'former' comes attached to that now.
rows.display_text:
「Much to my displeasure, 'former' comes
attached to that now.」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: But if I capture the daughter of Wulgusk's lord, who went on the Exodus, I'll have a chance to get back into the military.
rows.display_text:
「But if I capture Wulgusk's lord's
daughter, who joined the Exodus, I'd have
a shot at getting back into the military.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: We're running, Ana! You're his target!
rows.display_text: 「We're running, Ana! You're his target!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Too late! Now, come with me.
rows.display_text: 「Too late! Now, come with me.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Kyaah! Linck, Rinna, Lins!!
rows.display_text: 「Kyaah! Linck, Rinna, Lins!!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Wh-what are these rats!? Get out of my way!!
rows.display_text:
「Wh-what are these rats!? Get out of
my way!!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Now's our chance! Run, Ana!
rows.display_text: 「Now's our chance! Run, Ana!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Y-yes!!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes!!」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: ...Ana...! It's really you, Ana!?
rows.display_text: 「...Ana...! It's really you, Ana!?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Yes, Father! It's been a long time, but it's really me, Ana.
rows.display_text:
「Yes, Father! It's been a long time, but
it's really me, Ana.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: Oh, Ana...
rows.display_text: 「Oh, Ana...」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: So, Father... how are things in Wulgusk?
rows.display_text: 「So, Father... how are things in Wulgusk?」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Has Sibe Rail been giving you and the others trouble because our Exodus succeeded?
rows.display_text:
「Has Sibe Rail been giving you and the
others trouble because our Exodus
succeeded?」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: That's...
rows.display_text: 「That's...」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: I knew it, then...!? Sibe Rail has been targeting Wulgusk!
rows.display_text:
「I knew it, then...!? Sibe Rail has been
targeting Wulgusk!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: I'm... going back to Siberia no matter what. And I'll be by your side, Father...
rows.display_text:
「I'm... going back to Siberia no matter
what. And I'll be by your side, Father...」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: I won't allow it!
rows.display_text: 「I won't allow it!」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: I don't want to see the face of an unfilial daughter who ran off on the Exodus!
rows.display_text:
「I don't want to see the face of an
unfilial daughter who ran off on the
Exodus!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Father...
rows.display_text: 「Father...」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: You're disowned! I won't allow you to come back, Ana!
rows.display_text:
「You're disowned! I won't allow you to
come back, Ana!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Father...!
rows.display_text: 「Father...!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Wait, Ana! Ana!
rows.display_text: 「Wait, Ana! Ana!」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: Ana...

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Even for a parent, that's going too far...! That girl was worried about you for real!
rows.display_text:
「Even for a parent, that's going too
far...! That girl was worried about you
for real!」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: ...I am her parent. I know that much.
rows.display_text: 「...I am her parent. I know that much.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: You...

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: It's a time like this... There's no telling when Wulgusk might be swallowed by war and the Medaiyu house destroyed.
rows.display_text:
「It's a time like this... There's no
telling when Wulgusk might be swallowed
by war and the Medaiyu house destroyed.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: That's exactly why I want Ana to broaden her horizons and gain the wisdom and strength to live on her own.
rows.display_text:
「That's exactly why I want Ana to
broaden her horizons and gain the wisdom
and strength to live on her own.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: So that's why you said such harsh words...
rows.display_text:
「So that's why you said such harsh
words...」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: As long as Ana is alive, the Medaiyu bloodline won't die out...
rows.display_text:
「As long as Ana is alive, the Medaiyu
bloodline won't die out...」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: I don't know who you are, but it seems Ana trusts you.
rows.display_text:
「I don't know who you are, but it seems
Ana trusts you.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: I have no right to ask this of you, but please, I beg you to look after that girl.
rows.display_text:
「I have no right to ask this of you,
but please, I beg you to look after that
girl.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: ...Family's a good thing, isn't it.
rows.display_text: 「...Family's a good thing, isn't it.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: Ma'am...
rows.display_text: 「Ma'am...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Leave it to me, Duke Medaiyu. That girl is a precious comrade of mine, and a dear student too.
rows.display_text:
「Leave it to me, Duke Medaiyu. That girl
is a precious comrade of mine, and a dear
student too.」

rows.speaker: Medaiyu
rows.en: Oh... so you're someone in the teaching profession.
rows.display_text:
「Oh... so you're someone in the teaching
profession.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Just leave it to Teacher Adette here. I promise I'll protect that girl.
rows.display_text:
「Just leave it to Teacher Adette here. I
promise I'll protect that girl.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: And when this journey's over, I'll deliver her right back to you. So make sure you live long enough to see that day.
rows.display_text:
「And once this journey's over, I'll
deliver her right back to you. So live
long enough to see that day.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: ...Father... Father... eh... uuh...
rows.display_text: 「...Father... Father... eh... uuh...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Good work, little rats. Leave the rest to me.
rows.display_text:
「Good work, little rats. Leave the rest
to me.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Teacher Adette... I... I... *hic*...
rows.display_text: 「Teacher Adette... I... I... *hic*...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Ana... your father, you know...
rows.display_text: 「Ana... your father, you know...」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Uu... please don't think... *sob*... that Father is a terrible person...
rows.display_text:
「Uu... please don't think... *sob*...
that Father is a terrible person...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Eh...

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Uuh... Father... surely... u... wanted to tell me... to not worry about him... *hic*... and keep going on my journey...
rows.display_text:
「Uuh... Father... surely... u... wanted to
tell me... to not worry about him...
*hic*... and keep going on my journey...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Ana...

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Thank you, Father! I'll... make you proud as a daughter of the Medaiyu house!
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Father! I'll... make you
proud as a daughter of the Medaiyu
house!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Waaah! Waaah!! Fatherrrrr!!
rows.display_text: 「Waaah! Waaah!! Fatherrrrr!!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: (Cry all you want, Ana... It's just the two of us here, after all.)
rows.display_text:
（(Cry all you want, Ana... It's just the
two of us here, after all.)）

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: (Cry your heart out today... I'll stay with you until you've had enough...)
rows.display_text:
（(Cry your heart out today... I'll stay
with you until you've had enough...)）
